Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: a finished GentlePath web illustration, one asset only.
Input images: images 1–4 are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY, all user-approved existing GentlePath illustrations. Do not alter these references. Make a NEW illustration with the subject below that belongs to the EXACT same illustration family.
Style/medium: contemporary editorial spot illustration, clean rounded silhouettes, fine consistent dark forest-green hand-inked contours, broad flat soft-color shapes, barely visible fine paper grain and restrained soft tonal variation WITHIN shapes. Match the reference line weight, simple leaf construction and limited detail. Warm and adult, clear and calm at thumbnail scale.
Palette: deep forest green #174e46 / #123e39, soft sage #b8c9b0, pale mint #dbe6d7, pastel lilac #d8c5e9, warm ivory #fffaf0 and one small buttery sun-yellow #f7d477 accent.
Background: genuine RGBA transparency around and between all isolated shapes, crisp clean cutout edges, no colored matte, no painted background rectangle, no aura or fog or glow.
Constraints: no text, letters, words, numbers, logos or watermark. No realistic landscape, watercolor washes, vintage storybook painting, detailed foliage, wood grain, dense scenery, heavy 3D modeling, glossy shading, drop shadows or photorealism. Entire silhouette visible, comfortable clear margin on every side. One cohesive composition, no contact sheet, no panels.
Primary request: replace path-landscape-v2 with a simplified hopeful landscape in exactly the winding-path reference style.
Subject: an ivory S-shaped path crossing three broad rolling sage and deep-forest hills, a simple warm yellow circular sun above, one lilac butterfly, and two spare large-leaf botanical stems framing the scene. No trees, individual grasses, distant mountains, clouds, flowers or intricate landscape detail.
Composition/framing: horizontal 3:2 canvas; isolated balanced landscape vignette occupying about 84% of the width and 76% of the height; transparent sky and transparent space outside the organic hill silhouette. Clear margins, fully visible sun. The path moves from a broad welcoming foreground toward a calm horizon. Match the simplicity of reference image 1.

Primary request: a new community-garden-v2 illustration of welcoming conversation growing in a garden.
Subject: two broad rounded speech bubbles, one pale sage and one lilac, each with three forest-green dots; they emerge above a low organic green garden base. One tall simple four-leaf sprig behind them and one short two-leaf sprig in front, one small yellow sun above. Let the speech bubbles dominate; keep the plants very spare.
Composition/framing: horizontal 3:2 transparent canvas, a compact centered vignette, fully visible silhouettes with 10% margin. Use the refined graphic conversation treatment of the community-messages reference, arranged as a wider garden composition rather than copying it.

Primary request: a new reading-garden-v2 illustration of a quiet place to read and learn.
Subject: one beautiful open ivory book with a lilac cover and a broad forest-green curved spine, seen from a gentle three-quarter angle. Its left page has one simple sage leafy motif and its right page has two short sage strokes suggesting content. A spare four-leaf botanical sprig rises behind the book; a small yellow sun and one little lilac butterfly float above. The book is the clear hero.

Primary request: fully redesign the state-selection onboarding illustration as a clean contemporary illustrated US map.
Subject: a recognizable contiguous United States silhouette, pale sage fill with a fine dark forest outline, one large lilac location pin with a small ivory circular center, and just two simple broad-leaf botanical sprigs framing the lower corners. One small warm yellow circular sun floats above. Keep the silhouette recognizable, particularly California, Texas, Florida, New England and the Great Lakes indentation. Do not draw individual state boundaries; use a few large subtle sage and mint color regions inside the silhouette to keep it simple. This is symbolic onboarding artwork rather than a cartographic interface.
Composition/framing: horizontal 3:2 transparent canvas. Map is the strong central subject, pin raised over the center; compact calm wide composition with at least 9% clear padding. Match care-folder and community-messages's simple clean ink outlines and pastel opaque fills. No wreath, tiny flowers, detailed foliage, weathering or glowing halo.

Primary request: replace the dated not-found-page garden with a simple welcoming wayfinding illustration.
Subject: an ivory path gently curving between two broad low sage hill shapes. Beside it stands one simple lilac arrow-shaped sign with a dark forest post, pointing toward the path. Just two spare leafy stems, one little lilac butterfly and a small yellow circular sun complete the composition. The sign is perfectly blank, no text. Use graphic flat shapes, no wood grain or realistic tree.
Composition/framing: horizontal 3:2 transparent canvas. A quiet centered isolated vignette with every shape fully visible and generous padding. Match the winding-path style reference, but make the blank sign a clear distinct focal point for finding your way back.

Primary request: create a fresh Guided Steps illustration, replacing the old clipboard with an open route guide.
Subject: one softly folded ivory paper guide with a lilac back edge, standing in a gentle three-quarter view. A simple sage winding route links exactly three large round step markers on the paper; two markers contain a dark forest check, and the last contains a small simple two-leaf sprout. One spare broad-leaf sage sprig grows beside the folded guide, and a small buttery yellow circle sits behind its upper corner. Primary request: create a completely fresh Milestone Garden illustration about gentle personal growth, replacing the old trail of stone platforms.
Subject: three simple growing plants grouped as one compact botanical vignette, each in a softly rounded little plant pot. On the left a small two-leaf sprout in a pale ivory pot, in the middle a medium four-leaf plant in a sage pot, and on the right a slightly taller plant with a single lilac five-petal flower and yellow center in a lilac pot. One small warm yellow sun above. All plants have clean forest-green stems, broad simple sage leaves, and fine dark outlines. Do not make a bar chart; vary the overlaps and angles naturally.
